question: Will the Israel-Iran ceasefire hold through December 31, 2026?
resolution_criteria: Yes if neither Israel nor Iran carries out an air strike or surface-to-surface missile strike that impacts the other country's territory through December 31, 2026, 11:59 PM Iran time. Intercepted munitions, artillery, cyber attacks and ground raids do not count. Same rules as the Polymarket market.

history.rationale: starting at market, will adjust. Calibration-adjusted reading of the same price is 46.8%.
